notes: Shipping policy: 'Free shipping for all orders over $100 within the continental USA & APO'; ships internationally via FedEx, countries not listed (https://www.schottnyc.com/policies/shipping-policy).
Refund policy: returns and exchanges within 30 days from shipping, unworn with tags; first US exchange label free; US refunds deduct a $9.95 label (https://www.schottnyc.com/policies/refund-policy).

Leather jacket sizes: S–2XL on most, XS–6XL across the range, chest 32–54 on 16 styles; 'Made in USA' in 16 of 93 leather listings (https://www.schottnyc.com/collections/mens-leather-jackets/products.json).

Wikipedia: founded 1913 in New York City by Irving and Jack Schott; still owned by the Schott family; 'still manufacture[s] much of their clothing in the United States'; Perfecto designed 1928 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schott_NYC).
